in_hindi.name: लनवंश
in_hindi.meaning: वंश (vansh) = वंशी (vanshi) = वंशद (vanshad) = वंशक (vanshak) = descendants, lineage

in_marathi.name: Lanvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Hanuman's blessings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lanvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lan' meaning 'Lord Hanuman' and 'Vansh' meaning 'lineage' or 'blessings'. This name is a tribute to the monkey god Hanuman, who is known for his strength, courage, and loyalty. The name signifies that the child will be blessed by Lord Hanuman and will embody his qualities.
